header.subtitle: why page one shows up before row ten thousand

source.label: THE DATABASE
source.sub: finds matching rows one by one

payloads: the query matched ten thousand orders and the app waited for every one of them to load into memory before it drew a single row on the screen for you
with a limit and a cursor the first page of fifty rows comes back right away and the next page is only fetched when you actually scroll down to it

captions.text: why does this table take ages to appear?
every row was loaded before any was drawn.
pagination fetches one small page at a time.
you see page one while the rest can wait.

credits.tail: = fetch a page, not the whole table
